correctness.rationale: For arbitrary part sizes, match the three actual parts to their size-four caps; through four EF rounds repeats can be matched and fewer than four earlier picks cannot exhaust a capped-large part. This preserves equality and all ternary edge atoms. For the 20 sorted capped profiles, a separate full-vertex, pairwise EF recursion checked all 190 distinct pairs, requiring both directions of the one-move extension condition. Its nine classes agree exactly with the stated truncation-and-merger rule, including (2,2,3) with (2,3,3). The representative minima follow by the table and monotone capping, and the class of (3,3,3) requires every part to have at least three vertices. The sharp nine-vertex bound is internal to the family only.
